title: WordleGame
description: Wordle brought to Minecraft, play using /wordle
body:
# Welcome to Wordle!
a Minecraft Wordle clone plugin for your server

## How to play
to play just run:
```
/wordle
```

Don't like that game?
```
/wordle refresh
```

## Game Mechanics
1. A dialog interface with a keyboard to type whatever word you desire:</br>![Game's Dialog Interface](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c4c82392f90573a2d2003f643706436b27ec55f_0.webp)
2. Well not every word, just valid ones:</br>![Error Message](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/79548c77ca94e928fd2e28230941ed8987868ab9_0.webp)
3. When you finish a grid of your game will be sent to you</br>![Game Grid](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/23ddd6820ba02bc325636d20c7c7bb0f41d42e2a_0.webp)
